consequence.statement: For MESH_EXTERNAL services, DestinationRule certificates are now used instead of metadata certificates, so TLS origination behaviour may differ.
consequence.remediation: Set PREFER_DESTINATIONRULE_TLS_FOR_EXTERNAL_SERVICES to false to revert to the previous behaviour.

assertion.statement: Istio now honours DestinationRule certificates over metadata certificates for MESH_EXTERNAL services; setting env var PREFER_DESTINATIONRULE_TLS_FOR_EXTERNAL_SERVICES to false reverts this.
